name: @aeci/agent
description: Spike: Flue-based agent Worker for catalog Q&A. Hand-deployed only (not deployed by CI).

scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && wrangler deploy -c dist/aeci_agent/wrangler.json --var COMMIT_SHA:$(git rev-parse HEAD) --var DEPLOYED_AT:$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z)
scripts.deploy:production: pnpm run build:production && wrangler deploy -c dist/aeci_agent/wrangler.json --var COMMIT_SHA:$(git rev-parse HEAD) --var DEPLOYED_AT:$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z)
scripts.deploy:dry-run: pnpm run build && wrangler deploy --dry-run -c dist/aeci_agent/wrangler.json
scripts.deploy:dry-run:production: pnpm run build:production && wrangler deploy --dry-run -c dist/aeci_agent/wrangler.json
